season-23-forever-forward.detail:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Forever Forward!

In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.



Bonuses

GO Pass Major Milestone Bonuses

Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses. Once unlocked, these bonuses will last until the current GO Pass ends!

Rank 1

One additional Candy for trading Pokémon

Rank 25

Increased limits on opening, receiving from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts

Rank 50

2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

Rank 75

Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

Features

Pokémon GO Fest 2026

Join millions of Trainers across the globe for Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global on July 11 and 12, 2026! Take part in this worldwide event featuring Mewtwo and Zeraora.

Great news, Trainers—Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global is FREE for all Trainers logged in during the event weekend. That means Special Research, additional bonuses, and an increased chance of encountering Shiny Pokémon are available to all Trainers at no cost!

Up for an even bigger adventure? Then join us for our three in-person Pokémon GO Fest events in Tokyo, Chicago, and Copenhagen!

Mega Mewtwo Debuts

Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y, the Mega Evolutions of the Genetic Pokémon Mewtwo, will make their Pokémon GO debuts during Pokémon GO Fest 2026!

Check out the Pokémon GO blog for more information on how Trainers will be able to transform their Mewtwo into these forms for the first time in Pokémon GO!

Mega-Evolved Pokémon Debuts

Keep an eye out for more Mega-Evolved Pokémon debuts in Mega Raid Days during Forever Forward!

Max Pokémon Debuts

Dynamax Electabuzz, Dynamax Magikarp, Dynamax Feebas, and more will make their way into Max Battles throughout the Season. Keep an eye out for new Dynamax Pokémon at Power Spots!

    Daily Discoveries

    Continuing in Forever Forward, different days of the week will include a Daily Discovery experience. These will be active between 12:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m. local time unless otherwise stated. Starting Monday, June 15, these are the updated bonuses for Forever Forward. Daily Discoveries may change as we experiment with how to make the best experience.

    Please note: Daily Discoveries will not be available during the week of global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, and GO Tour events.

    SUNDAY
    Scenic Sunday
    • More Pokémon will appear in the wild! [NEW]
    • More Pokémon will appear while following a Route. Incense will attract even more Pokémon on Routes.
    • Reduced distance to earn Buddy Candy while exploring Routes with your Buddy Pokémon.
    • Encounter Mateo up to three times each day while on a Route.
    MONDAY
    Max Monday*
    • One guaranteed Rare Candy XL for winning in-person Max Battles [New]
    • Power Spots will refresh more frequently.
    • Additional Power Spots will be active on Mondays compared to the rest of the week.
    • Max Battles will rotate to feature different Dynamax Pokémon.
    *Max Battles will be available between 6:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m. local time. Power Spot availability will be limited outside of Max Mondays and Max Battle Days.
    TUESDAY
    Showcase Tuesday
    • Trainers can enter up to five PokéStop Showcases.
    • More PokéStops may have PokéStop Showcases.
    WEDNESDAY
    Raid Hour
    • One Rare Candy XL for completing in-person Raid Battles. [NEW]
    • Raid Bosses for five-star raids and Mega Raids will rotate at the start of the day each week.
    • Raid Hours will continue to feature the five-star Raid Boss between 6:00 p.m. and 7:00 p.m. local time.
    THURSDAY
    GO Battle Thursdays and Spotlight Hour
    • Spotlight Hour will return from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time. [NEW]
    FRIDAY
    Friendship Friday*
    • Up to two additional Special Trades.
    • Increased chance of Lucky Trade for any trade.
    • Trades will require 20% less Stardust.
    • Two guaranteed Candy XL from trades (Trainers level 31+).
    *These bonuses only apply to in-person trades.

    Community Days

    Mark your calendar! Forever Forward will have Community Day events on the following dates.

    • June 20 — June Community Day
    • July 4 — July Community Day
    • August 16 — August Community Day

    GO Pass

    GO Pass, a limited-time progression track, will be available during Forever Forward! Complete Pass Tasks to earn GO Points to increase your rank and earn rewards.

    The GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass, will be available for Trainers looking for upgraded rewards and faster progression.

    GO Battle League

    The GO Battle League returns as part of Forever Forward! Get your Pokémon ready to battle in competitions such as the North American International Championships 2026 Cup, Fantasy Cup, Sunshine Cup, and more!

    Visit the GO Battle League web page for the schedule and more info!

    Research Breakthrough

    Complete Field Research to unlock Research Breakthrough encounters with one of the following Pokémon.

    • Dragonite

    • Indeedee (Male)

season-23-forever-forward.detail_ms:
Selamat datang ke Pokémon GO: Forever Forward!

Dalam Pokémon GO, Musim ialah tempoh masa yang menampilkan acara baharu, kemunculan sulung Pokémon, dan kejutan yang semuanya mengikut tema tertentu. Apabila Musim berubah, anda mungkin akan melihat Pokémon berbeza muncul di kawasan anda dan menetas daripada Telur. Pastikan anda meneroka sepanjang setiap Musim dalam permainan untuk mengumpul dan melatih seberapa banyak Pokémon berbeza yang anda boleh! Anda juga akan menikmati bonus istimewa sepanjang berbuat demikian.



Bonus

Bonus Pencapaian Utama GO Pass

Capai Pencapaian Utama pada GO Pass anda untuk membuka bonus berikut. Setelah dibuka, bonus ini akan kekal sehingga GO Pass semasa tamat!

Peringkat 1

Satu Gula-gula tambahan untuk perdagangan Pokémon

Peringkat 25

Had peningkatan untuk membuka, menerima daripada Cakera Foto PokéStop dan Gim, serta menyimpan Hadiah

Peringkat 50

Tempoh Kemenyan Pengembaraan Harian 2×

Peringkat 75

XP dan Stardust meningkat daripada penetasan Telur

Ciri-ciri

Pokémon GO Fest 2026

Sertai berjuta-juta Trainer di seluruh dunia untuk Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global pada 11 dan 12 Julai 2026! Sertai acara global ini yang menampilkan Mewtwo dan Zeraora.

Berita baik, Trainer—Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global adalah PERCUMA untuk semua Trainer yang log masuk sepanjang hujung minggu acara. Ini bermakna Penyelidikan Khas, bonus tambahan, dan peluang lebih tinggi untuk bertemu Pokémon Shiny tersedia untuk semua Trainer tanpa sebarang kos!

Bersedia untuk pengembaraan yang lebih besar? Sertai kami untuk tiga acara Pokémon GO Fest secara bersemuka di Tokyo, Chicago, dan Copenhagen!

Mega Mewtwo Debut

Mega Mewtwo X dan Mega Mewtwo Y, iaitu Mega Evolution bagi Pokémon Genetik Mewtwo, akan membuat debut Pokémon GO mereka semasa Pokémon GO Fest 2026!

Semak blog Pokémon GO untuk maklumat lanjut tentang cara Trainers akan dapat mengubah Mewtwo mereka kepada bentuk ini buat kali pertama dalam Pokémon GO!

Debut Pokémon Mega-Evolved

Perhatikan debut lebih banyak Pokémon Mega-Evolved dalam Mega Raid Days sepanjang Forever Forward!

Kemunculan Perdana Max Pokémon

Dynamax Electabuzz, Dynamax Magikarp, Dynamax Feebas, dan banyak lagi akan muncul dalam Max Battles sepanjang Musim ini. Teruskan mata anda untuk Dynamax Pokémon baharu di Power Spots!

    Penemuan Harian

    Meneruskan Forever Forward, hari-hari tertentu dalam seminggu akan merangkumi pengalaman Penemuan Harian. Ini akan aktif antara 12:00 pagi dan 11:59 malam waktu tempatan melainkan dinyatakan sebaliknya. Bermula Isnin, 15 Jun, ini adalah bonus terkini untuk Forever Forward. Penemuan Harian mungkin berubah semasa kami mencuba untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik.

    Sila ambil perhatian: Penemuan Harian tidak akan tersedia sepanjang minggu acara global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, dan GO Tour.

    AHAD
    Ahad Indah
    • Lebih banyak Pokémon akan muncul di alam liar! [BARU]
    • Lebih banyak Pokémon akan muncul semasa mengikuti Route. Incense akan menarik lebih banyak Pokémon di Routes.
    • Jarak yang dikurangkan untuk mendapatkan Buddy Candy semasa meneroka Routes dengan Buddy Pokémon anda.
    • Temui Mateo sehingga tiga kali setiap hari semasa berada di Route.
    ISNIN
    Max Isnin*
    • Satu Rare Candy XL dijamin untuk memenangi Max Battles secara bersemuka [Baru]
    • Power Spots akan segar semula dengan lebih kerap.
    • Power Spots tambahan akan aktif pada hari Isnin berbanding hari lain dalam minggu.
    • Max Battles akan berputar untuk menampilkan Dynamax Pokémon yang berbeza.
    *Max Battles akan tersedia antara 6:00 pagi dan 9:00 malam waktu tempatan. Ketersediaan Power Spot akan dihadkan di luar Max Isnin dan Hari Max Battle.
    SELASA
    Selasa Showcase
    • Trainer boleh menyertai sehingga lima PokéStop Showcases.
    • Lebih banyak PokéStops mungkin mempunyai PokéStop Showcases.
    RABU
    Waktu Raid
    • Satu Rare Candy XL untuk menyelesaikan Raid Battles secara bersemuka. [BARU]
    • Raid Bosses untuk raid lima bintang dan Mega Raids akan berputar pada awal hari setiap minggu.
    • Waktu Raid akan terus menampilkan Raid Boss lima bintang antara 6:00 petang dan 7:00 malam waktu tempatan.
    KHAMIS
    Khamis GO Battle dan Waktu Sorotan
    • Waktu Sorotan akan kembali dari 6:00 petang hingga 7:00 malam waktu tempatan. [BARU]
    JUMAAT
    Jumaat Persahabatan*
    • Sehingga dua Trade Khas tambahan.
    • Peluang meningkat untuk Lucky Trade bagi sebarang trade.
    • Trade akan memerlukan 20% kurang Stardust.
    • Dua Candy XL dijamin daripada trade (Trainer tahap 31+).
    *Bonus ini hanya terpakai untuk trade secara bersemuka.

    Hari Komuniti

    Tandakan kalendar anda! Forever Forward akan mengadakan acara Hari Komuniti pada tarikh-tarikh berikut.

    • June 20 — Hari Komuniti Jun
    • July 4 — Hari Komuniti Julai

    GO Pass

    GO Pass, trek kemajuan untuk masa terhad, akan tersedia semasa Forever Forward! Selesaikan Tugas Pass untuk kumpul GO Points dan naikkan pangkat anda untuk dapatkan ganjaran.

    GO Pass Deluxe, versi berbayar GO Pass, akan tersedia untuk Trainer yang mahukan ganjaran lebih baik dan kemajuan lebih pantas.

    GO Battle League

    GO Battle League kembali sebagai sebahagian daripada Forever Forward! Sediakan Pokémon anda untuk bertarung dalam pertandingan seperti North American International Championships 2026 Cup, Fantasy Cup, Sunshine Cup, dan banyak lagi!

The Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership continues for Trainers in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia! Visit participating LEGO Store locations for raids, a LEGO-themed stamp rally, event stickers, and LEGO Pokémon SMART Play.

The LEGO Stores and Pokémon GO event will take place from August 3, 2026 at 10 am to September 30, 2026 at 11 pm.



Features

Stamp Rally

Take part in a special LEGO-themed stamp rally during the event! A stamp rally is an activity where you collect stamps at certain PokéStops and Gyms. Explore participating LEGO Stores and find designated stops to collect stamps, which leads to encounters with Pikachu that have a Special Background.

Stamps can be collected at select LEGO Stores in Australia, France, Great Britain, Germany, Poland, and the United States.

Trainers can start the stamp rally by visiting a participating LEGO Store until September 30, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. local time.

How stamp rallies work

Orange stamp icons will be displayed above the PokéStops included in the stamp rally. When you tap on these PokéStops, the stamp sheet will appear so you can collect your stamp.

You can view the stamps you collect on the stamp rally page in your Scrapbook. Certain stamp rallies also let you send stamps to your friends along with a Gift. Stamps you get from Gifts will be collected in your Scrapbook, but they don’t count toward the reward track. Rewards can only be obtained when you visit the location and collect the stamps yourself.

Learn more about how to participate in a stamp rally here!

  • Pikachu

LEGO Pokémon SMART Play

From August 3 to September 30, 2026, Trainers are invited to enter LEGO Stores in the US, UK, Poland, France, Germany, and Australia to visit in-store Trainer Centers and participate in the LEGO Pokémon SMART Play demo. Participants will receive a unique collectible SMART Play Tag and a special stamp for their LEGO Passports. Smart Tags are available while stocks last.

Timing of in-store activities may vary by market. Please go to lego.com/stores for more information about your local store. Availability of the free Smart Play tag giveaway item is limited and subject to stock remaining at participating locations.

Kerjasama antara Pokémon GO dan LEGO Group diteruskan untuk para Trainer di AS, UK, Poland, Perancis, Jerman, dan Australia! Kunjungi lokasi LEGO Store yang menyertainya untuk raid, perhimpunan setem bertemakan LEGO, pelekat acara, dan LEGO Pokémon SMART Play.

Acara LEGO Stores dan Pokémon GO akan berlangsung dari 3 Ogos 2026, jam 10 pagi hingga 30 September 2026, jam 11 malam.



Ciri-ciri

Lokasi Kedai LEGO yang Menyertai

Anda boleh gunakan peta interaktif ini untuk mencari kedai yang menyertai berhampiran anda. Senarai ini adalah daripada peta rasmi Stamp Rally.

Negara

Peta interaktif akan dimuatkan apabila ia hampir dengan skrin.

Buka peta rasmi

Perhimpunan Setem

Sertai perhimpunan setem bertemakan LEGO yang istimewa semasa acara ini! Perhimpunan setem ialah aktiviti di mana anda mengumpul setem di PokéStop dan Gym tertentu. Terokai Kedai LEGO yang terlibat dan cari perhentian yang ditetapkan untuk mengumpul setem, yang membawa kepada pertemuan dengan Pikachu yang mempunyai Latar Belakang Khas.

Setem boleh dikumpul di Kedai LEGO terpilih di Australia, Perancis, Great Britain, Jerman, Poland, dan Amerika Syarikat.

Trainer boleh memulakan perhimpunan setem dengan melawat Kedai LEGO yang terlibat sehingga 30 September 2026, jam 11:59 malam waktu tempatan.

Cara perhimpunan setem berfungsi

Ikon setem oren akan dipaparkan di atas PokéStop yang termasuk dalam perhimpunan setem. Apabila anda mengetik PokéStop ini, helaian setem akan muncul supaya anda boleh mengumpul setem anda.

Anda boleh melihat setem yang anda kumpul di halaman perhimpunan setem dalam Scrapbook anda. Sesetengah perhimpunan setem juga membenarkan anda menghantar setem kepada rakan anda bersama-sama dengan Hadiah. Setem yang anda terima daripada Hadiah akan dikumpul dalam Scrapbook anda, tetapi ia tidak dikira ke arah trek ganjaran. Ganjaran hanya boleh diperoleh apabila anda melawat lokasi dan mengumpul setem sendiri.

Ketahui lebih lanjut tentang cara menyertai perhimpunan setem di sini!

  • Pikachu

LEGO Pokémon SMART Play

Dari 3 Ogos hingga 30 September 2026, para Trainer dijemput untuk masuk ke Kedai LEGO di AS, UK, Poland, Perancis, Jerman, dan Australia untuk melawat Pusat Trainer di dalam kedai dan menyertai demo LEGO Pokémon SMART Play. Peserta akan menerima Tag SMART Play koleksi yang unik dan setem khas untuk Pasport LEGO mereka. Tag SMART tersedia selagi stok masih ada.

Masa aktiviti dalam kedai mungkin berbeza mengikut pasaran. Sila pergi ke lego.com/stores untuk maklumat lanjut tentang kedai tempatan anda. Ketersediaan item pemberian Tag Smart Play percuma adalah terhad dan tertakluk kepada stok yang tinggal di lokasi yang mengambil bahagian.

The Lucky Trinket returns and Latias soars into GO Pass: August!

The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for August will be available from August 4, 2026 at 10:00 am to September 8, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.



Features

GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: August on Tuesday, August 4, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, September 8, at 10:00 a.m. local time.

Additionally, from Saturday, September 5, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, September 6, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!

For US$7.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.

For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.

Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, September 10, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

*All prices listed are in USD or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency. Availability of event tickets and the GO Pass Deluxe may vary by region.

Featured Pokémon and Rewards

Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.

  • Encounter with Latias*

  • And even more goodies!

Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.

  • A Lucky Trinket
  • Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!

*You might even encounter a Shiny one—if you’re lucky!

Major Milestone Bonuses

Tier 2 – Rank 25

Hold up to 20 more Gifts in your Item Bag

Lucky Trinket

The Lucky Trinket will return as the final reward in this month’s GO Pass Deluxe.

A Lucky Trinket is a one-time-use item that can be used to turn one friend from your Friend List into a Lucky Friend. When used, the Lucky Trinket will set the status of you and your chosen friend to Lucky, even if you aren’t Best Friends yet! When you’re Lucky Friends with someone, the next time you trade with each other, both Pokémon will become Lucky Pokémon. After the trade, your Lucky Friend status will be cleared.

This exciting item will only stay in your Item Bag for a limited time, so don’t forget to use it! The Lucky Trinket earned as a part of GO Pass Deluxe: August will expire on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time, regardless of when you claimed it.

You must be at least Great Friends with the Trainer you wish to apply your Lucky Trinket to. You cannot use a Lucky Trinket with a Trainer you are currently Lucky Friends with. Using a Lucky Trinket on a friend does not change the distance at which you can complete a trade. If you do not want to allow other Trainers to use their Lucky Trinkets on you, you can disable this permission in your Settings page.

Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks or the various accomplishments listed here. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.

Lucky Trinket akan kembali sebagai ganjaran terakhir dalam GO Pass Deluxe bulan ini.

Lucky Trinket ialah item kegunaan sekali sahaja yang boleh digunakan untuk menjadikan seorang rakan daripada Senarai Rakan anda sebagai Lucky Friend. Apabila digunakan, Lucky Trinket akan menetapkan status anda dan rakan pilihan anda kepada Lucky, walaupun anda belum lagi menjadi Best Friends! How to use Twitch Drops

Follow the Twitch Channels
Follow Twitch.tv/PokemonGO, Twitch.tv/Pokemon, and Twitch.tv/PokemonXP so you'll get a notification when the broadcasts begin.

Connect your Pokémon Trainer Club account to Twitch by following steps 1–3 on rewards.pokemon.com.

Rally with Trainers around the world for the mega conclusion of Pokémon GO Fest 2026! Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale brings rotating habitats, powerful Mega Raids, and Super Mega Raids featuring Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y.

Prepare during the lead-up event Mega Ascension, then join this unticketed worldwide weekend finale.

The Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale event will take place from September 5, 2026 at 10 am to September 6, 2026 at 6 pm local time.



Bonuses

No limit on Remote Raids from Saturday, September 5, to Sunday, September 6, 2026
All Mega-Evolved Pokémon will receive an extra CP boost from Saturday, September 5, to Sunday, September 6, 2026

Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: Mega Finale can also earn the following rewards.

Bonus Candy, Candy XL, and XP from Mega Raids
Increased chance of encountering Shiny Pokémon from certain Mega Raids and event Pokémon encounters

Features

Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, and Mega Greninja

During the lead-up and the main event weekend, Trainers can choose Chespin, Fennekin, or Froakie to begin a Mega Evolution–focused journey leading to Mega Evolving them into Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, or Mega Greninja.

Pokémon GO’s most Mega event yet

Brace yourselves for the return of many Mega-Evolved Pokémon that have appeared in Pokémon GO. Don’t miss these mega challenges and the chance to catch them!

New Special Backgrounds

Pokémon caught from Mega Raids during the Mega Ascension event and Mega Finale weekend may have a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background.

Starting during the Mega Ascension event, when a Pokémon with a Mega Evolution–themed Special Background is Mega Evolved, its background will have additional effects for the duration of the Mega Evolution.

Choose your Kalos first partner Pokémon

Start your journey by completing branching Timed Research where you can choose Chespin, Fennekin, or Froakie. Complete this Timed Research to get GO Pass: Mega Finale, which will include rewards to help you Mega Evolve the Pokémon you chose!

The free GO Pass: Mega Finale includes enough Mega Energy to Mega Evolve your chosen partner once. Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can earn enough additional Mega Energy to raise their chosen partner’s Mega Level.

Habitats and Raid Schedule

There are a total of eight habitats. Four will appear each event day two times each.

Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y will appear in Super Mega Raids at certain Gyms. At all other Gyms, only Mega Raids will appear during event hours. Raid Bosses will rotate with the active habitat.

Daily Discoveries, Seasonal Mega Raids, Seasonal Five-Star Raids, Seasonal Shadow Raids, Seasonal Raid Hours, and Seasonal Spotlight Hours will not take place during the Mega Ascension event and Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale. Find your community

You don’t have to take on the Mega Finale alone. Find your community to rally fellow Trainers, plan raids, and make the most of the event.

season-24-twilight-trails.detail:
Welcome to Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails!

In Pokémon GO, Seasons are periods of time that feature new events, Pokémon debuts, and surprises that all follow a certain theme. As the Seasons change, you may find different Pokémon appearing in your area and hatching from Eggs. Make sure to explore during each in-game Season to collect and train as many different Pokémon as you can! You’ll also enjoy special bonuses as you do.



Bonuses

GO Pass Major Milestone Bonuses

Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses. Once unlocked, these bonuses will last until the current GO Pass ends!

Rank 1

One guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon for Trainers level 31 and above
One additional Candy for trading Pokémon

Rank 25

Increased limits on opening Gifts, receiving Gifts from PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs, and storing Gifts

Rank 50

2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

Rank 75

Increased XP and Stardust from hatching Eggs

Features

Pokémon Debuts

More Pokémon originally discovered in the Paldea region, which was featured in the Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet games for Nintendo Switch, have been spotted in Pokémon GO!

Be on the lookout for Maschiff, Mabosstiff, and more!

  • Maschiff
  • Mabosstiff

Mega-Evolved Pokémon

Where Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale ends, a new trail begins! Gather ‘round for the Mega Evolution debuts of Staraptor, Chandelure, and more during Twilight Trails.

Stay tuned for more details on how to continue your Mega Evolution journey with the Mega Squads event, September Community Day Classic, and more!

Max Pokémon Debuts

Dynamax Rhyhorn, Dynamax Sneasel, Dynamax Sizzlipede, and more will make their way into Max Battles throughout the Season. Keep an eye out for new Dynamax Pokémon at Power Spots!

Dynamax Uxie, Dynamax Mesprit, and Dynamax Azelf will appear in a Max Battle Day during Twilight Trails.

Please note: Daily Discoveries will not be available during the week of global GO Fest, GO Wild Area, and GO Tour events.

SUNDAY

Apabila Seasons berubah, anda mungkin akan melihat Pokémon berbeza muncul di kawasan anda dan menetas daripada Telur. Pastikan anda meneroka semasa setiap Season dalam permainan untuk mengumpul dan melatih seberapa banyak Pokémon yang anda boleh! Anda juga akan menikmati bonus istimewa sepanjang berbuat demikian.

Satu Candy tambahan untuk menukar Pokémon

Latios soars in faster than a jet for GO Pass: September!

The GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe for September will be available from September 8, 2026 at 10:00 am to October 6, 2026 at 10:00 am local time.



Features

GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe

Trainers will automatically receive GO Pass: September on Tuesday, September 8, at 10:00 a.m. local time. You can collect GO Points and rank up to get additional rewards through Tuesday, October 6, at 10:00 a.m. local time.

Additionally, from Saturday, October 3, at 12:00 a.m. to Sunday, October 4, at 11:59 p.m. local time, there’s no daily limit for how many GO Points you can earn!

For US$7.99, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe, a paid version of the GO Pass that offers upgraded rewards and faster progression.

For US$9.99*, Trainers can upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe + 10 Ranks to also automatically earn enough GO Points to reach Rank 11.

While progressing through the GO Pass Deluxe, you’ll be able to claim all of the rewards from both the free GO Pass and GO Pass Deluxe. You can upgrade to a GO Pass Deluxe at any time and still collect rewards from previously unlocked ranks.

Rewards unlocked in the GO Pass will expire on Thursday, October 8, at 10:00 a.m. local time, so be sure to claim your rewards before they’re gone!

*All prices listed are in USD or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency. Availability of event tickets and the GO Pass Deluxe may vary by region.

Featured Pokémon and Rewards

Complete Pass Tasks to rank up your GO Pass to earn the following rewards.

  • Encounter with Latios*
  • Rare Candy XL
  • Premium Battle Pass
  • Lucky Egg
  • And even more goodies!

Trainers who upgrade to the GO Pass Deluxe can also earn the following rewards.

  • One Timed Incubator
  • One Super Incubator
  • Additional encounters with even more Pokémon!
  • And even more goodies!
*You might even encounter a Shiny one—if you’re lucky!

Major Milestone Bonuses

Reach Major Milestones on your GO Pass to unlock the following bonuses.

Tier 1 – Rank 1

One additional Candy for trading Pokémon
Trainers level 31 and above will receive one guaranteed Candy XL when trading Pokémon

Tier 2 – Rank 25

Open up to 40 Gifts per day
Receive up to 125 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs
Hold 10 more Gifts in your Item Bag

2× Daily Adventure Incense duration

Tier 2 – Rank 25

Open up to 50 Gifts per day
Receive up to 150 Gifts per day from spinning PokéStop and Gym Photo Discs
Hold up to 20 more Gifts in your Item Bag

The Timed Incubator

The Timed Incubator will be available on Rank 20 of GO Pass Deluxe: September!

This exciting item is an additional unlimited-use Incubator for hatching Eggs as you explore! The Timed Incubator will last from when it’s earned until one week after the current GO Pass ends.

The Timed Incubator earned as a part of GO Pass Deluxe: September will expire on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time, regardless of when you claimed it.*

*An Egg placed in a Timed Incubator that has not hatched by the expiration date will be placed in a new single-use Incubator to finish incubating. After the Egg hatches, the Incubator will disappear.

GO Pass

Earn points to increase your rank and unlock rewards. You can earn points by completing Pass Tasks or the various accomplishments listed here. Any rewards you earn for completing a Pass Task will be awarded as soon as you finish the task.

Trainers will also have access to Weekly Tasks to earn points and increase their rank. The Weekly Tasks are as follows:

  • Catch 75 Pokémon - 200 PTS
  • Win a raid - 150 PTS
  • Make 20 Great Throws - 150 PTS
  • Hatch 3 Eggs - 150 PTS
  • Spin 25 PokéStops or Gyms - 100 PTS
  • Use 20 Berries to help catch Pokémon - 100 PTS
  • Earn 10 hearts with your buddy - 150 PTS

There is also a daily task:

GO Pass: September Daily

  • Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS

GO Pass Deluxe: September Daily

  • Catch 15 Pokémon - 200 PTS

Trainers can earn up to 250 extra points daily by completing certain tasks.

  • Win a raid - 100 PTS
  • Hatch an Egg - 40 PTS
  • Catch a Pokémon - 5 PTS

Points / rank
BASIC

Sales

Pokémon GO Web Store

The GO Pass Deluxe, the paid version of the GO Pass, will also be available on the Pokémon GO Web Store! Your GO Pass Deluxe purchased via the Pokémon GO Web Store will activate as soon as the GO Pass begins.

Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: September on the Pokémon GO Web Store will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, one Premium Battle Pass, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Trainers who upgrade to GO Pass Deluxe: September + 10 Ranks will receive 10 Ultra Balls, five Max Revives, two Premium Battle Passes, and five Max Potions as a gift with purchase.

Or stock up on the essentials alongside your upgrade with the web-exclusive GO Pass Deluxe: September Ultra Box which includes 20 Ultra Balls, 10 Max Revives, 10 Max Potions, and five Premium Battle Passes as a gift with purchase!

Inkubator Bermasa

Item menarik ini ialah Inkubator tambahan tanpa had penggunaan untuk menetaskan Telur sambil anda meneroka! Inkubator Bermasa akan bertahan dari masa ia diperoleh sehingga seminggu selepas GO Pass semasa tamat.

Inkubator Bermasa yang diperoleh sebagai sebahagian daripada GO Pass Deluxe: September akan tamat pada Selasa, 13 Oktober 2026, jam 10:00 pagi waktu tempatan, tanpa mengira bila anda menuntutnya.*
